summary: This note is a short biography of Lady Barbara FitzRoy (1672–1737), the youngest of six children of Barbara Palmer, 1st Duchess of Cleveland. It explains that King Charles II, the duchess's lover, never publicly acknowledged her as his child because he was probably not her father. She later became a Benedictine nun under the name "Benedite".
one_line: Lady Barbara FitzRoy was the youngest child of the Duchess of Cleveland, later a Benedictine nun known as Benedite.
key_facts: Lady Barbara FitzRoy was born on 16 July 1672.
Lady Barbara FitzRoy died on 6 May 1737.
Lady Barbara FitzRoy was the sixth and youngest child of Barbara Palmer, 1st Duchess of Cleveland.
Barbara Palmer, 1st Duchess of Cleveland, was a mistress of Charles II of England.
Charles II never publicly acknowledged Lady Barbara FitzRoy as his child.
The note states that Charles II was probably not the father of Lady Barbara FitzRoy.
Lady Barbara FitzRoy became a Benedictine nun.
As a nun, Lady Barbara FitzRoy was known as "Benedite".
